application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
T1 Oak

Prune branches encroaching towards adjacent buildings by up to 2 metres, or to provide a maximum clearance of 3 metres from the building, pruning to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998.

Reason

The Council accepts that a degree of clearance pruning is reasonable to maintain separation between the tree and adjacent structures. The above specification achieves this objective whilst retaining the form, character and amenity value of the protected tree.
description:
Oak T1 in the rear garden. Reduce lateral height branches by 1 m. Reduce the width of the tree by up to 3m to suitable growth points.
The tree will stand at 12 m high with a spread of 12m.
The Reason for works is to stop interference with buildings and property and to contain the spread of the tree given its location in the garden.
